(4) A fork lifts a piece of crispy fried chicken topped with a thick, vibrant purple-colored sauce and a slice of lime. (5) A spoon scoops up soft white tofu cubes drenched in a thick, red-brown minced meat sauce with fresh green cilantro on top. (7) A close-up of a meatball being lifted, showing its pinkish interior and glistening sauce. (10) Four small roasted chicken drumsticks with bone-in ends are arranged on a blue plate with a wedge of lime. (11) Back to the iron skillet, the large meat roll on melted cheese is shown again, with sauce being drizzled and steam rising. (12) A fork pulls a piece of the meat roll, creating long, stretchy strings of melted cheese. (13) A piece of golden-fried tofu topped with grated white radish and green onions is lifted with chopsticks, revealing a soft yellow interior. (14) The shot returns to the empty dining room, then zooms in on a weathered, rusty metal sign attached to a textured wall, showing stylized characters and address information.
